'''Begubb''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Toydarian/Legends|Toydarian]] criminal [[Baron/Legends|baron]] who terrorized one of the villages on [[Ryloth/Legends|Ryloth]], demanding that the [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'leks]] pay him regular quotas of the [[Ryll/Legends|ryll]] [[Spice/Legends|spice]].

When the villagers, on one occasion, failed to pay him a full annual tribute (missing the quota by ten percent), Begubb accused the Twi'leks of having spent too much time with their children, nurturing and caring for them. As punishment, he took one of every ten children away from their parents. But in exacting that retribution, Begubb made sure to choose only the smartest and the prettiest of children, taking the girl [[Pala Kwi'teksa]] from her [[Pala Kwi'teksa's mother|mother]], who wailed in sorrow as Pala was wrenched from her arms. Then, as with so many others, the Toydarian baron criminally sold the child into slavery on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]], delivering her to the [[Crime lord/Legends|crimelord]] [[Gardulla Besadii the Elder/Legends|Gardulla the Hutt]], her first master. In 37 BBY, Gardulla sold Pala to [[Vansitt|Madame Vansitt]], to be trained in the fine arts of [[Spy/Legends|espionage]], political blackmail and [[Assassin/Legends|assassination]], at Vansitt's [[Mos Espa/Legends|Mos Espa]] '[[Madame Vansitt's Charm Academy|Charm Academy]]'.
